name: Hana Miki
source: One of the three biggest criminals at the school. Hana was suspended on the first day for stabbing another student with a pencil. Despite her good grades, she was held back many times due to her behavior. Hana liked idols ever since she was a kid. She is the vice president of the idol club.
translation: One of the three biggest criminals at the school. Hana was suspended on the first day for stabbing another student with a pencil. Despite her good grades, she was held back many times due to her behavior. Hana liked idols ever since she was a kid. She is the vice president of the idol club.
